summary.name: Itsypad
summary.one_liner: A tiny, fast macOS scratchpad text editor combined with a 1,000-item clipboard manager, with iCloud sync and an iOS/iPadOS companion app.
use_cases: quick scratch notes on a Mac
keeping multiple text snippets open in tabs
syncing quick notes between Mac and iPhone
summary.what_it_does: Itsypad is a native macOS text editor with multiple tabs (drag to reorder), split view right or down, find and replace, clickable links, and syntax highlighting for 185+ languages with automatic detection. Tabs, content and cursor positions persist across restarts. Its clipboard manager stores up to 1,000 text and image entries with search, keyboard navigation, grid or panel layout, and ⌘1–9 / ⌥1–9 shortcuts to copy or paste. Global hotkeys (triple-tap left ⌥, or custom) show or hide the app system-wide, and the window can be pinned on top. Optional iCloud sync covers scratch tabs and text clipboard entries across Macs and iOS/iPadOS devices.
notable: Clipboard history of up to 1,000 items with ⌘1–9 quick access and a separate global hotkey
Triple-tap left Option key to show or hide the window, even from fullscreen apps
Built with AppKit and Swift, no Electron or web views
Open source under the MIT licence
caveats: Mac app is free via Homebrew and GitHub; the iPhone/iPad app requires a one-time App Store purchase (universal purchase)
Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later and iOS/iPadOS 17 or later
iCloud sync covers scratch tabs and text clipboard entries, not every item type
